device: same 3528 white LED and same carrier tape

search.scope: two configured effective regions; complete image retained for contour and side-reference context
search.reduction: mean of all four source grayscale pixels in each 2x2 block
search.output_area: reduced foreground area times 4, estimate; 13-bit saturation
search.bbox: half-resolution component bbox mapped to 720p processing/display coordinates, padded by two pixels and clipped
search.border_acceleration: 44-cell horizontal-run proof (current3528 review max43); certify preceding10 full words through spare capture write slots; seed/neighbor skip; dark reference preserved; existing low-pass ignored map also accounts for recognized T100 rectangles, and sequential scan reads are prefetched; no new image RAM
search.membership: complete component center inside the region; no ROI crop of contour

diagnostics: SIZE: strict image dimensions not met
ASP: strict image aspect not met
FILL: strict bright-body fill not met
REF: side dark reference not met
0xF: generic low-gray FIT CHK / REVIEW; does not assert all four individual strict diagnostics failed

quality_classification.note: P10-P12 standing and P13-P15 flipped confirmed by user; unified placement-review candidates, no defect subtype classifier. Whole-tape rotation is not itself a defect. Pocket displacement removed.
